summary: Applied revision-02 security, idempotency, protocol, and collector fixes addressing orchestration/bootstrap/revision-02.md and reviews/bridge-v1-audit.md (A1, A2, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9): fail-closed post-click uncertainty preservation, symlink/temp-file escape prevention with random O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW writes + fsync + per-task flock, exact conversation & cross-attempt marker/contract verification with stronger echo filter and no URL corruption, multi-tab read-only reconciliation for uncertain/fresh state dirs, collector branch write-scope audit (verified vs scope_unverified), prior attempt snapshot validation, sanitized tests field and rejection of self-referential commit SHA in result.json, strict GitHub MCP error classification & file-content parser, strict duplicate-key JSON parsing, case/prefix path collision rejection, and hardened official URL validation.
revision_fixes: A1 (Fail-closed post-click uncertainty): cmd_submit now clears send_initiated=False ONLY on verified pre-click refusal ({clicked: False, reason: 'send_button_not_found' | 'send_button_disabled'}); any null, malformed, missing-clicked, or unknown post-click result remains state='submit_uncertain', send_initiated=True (exit 3) so retries reconcile read-only and never double-send.

A4 (Symlink/temp escape prevention, durability, locking): replaced predictable .tmp writes with random-suffix O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW (0o600) + fsync + os.replace + parent dir fsync; validated state_dir, jobs/, collected/, collect_root, intermediate directories, and target files against symlinks; wrapped OSError in BridgeError; added O_NOFOLLOW reads and non-blocking fcntl.flock per-task locking (journal_locked).

A2 & A6 (Exact conversation/attempt verification, echo filter, idempotency): cmd_status rejects --contract + mismatched --attempt, never falls back to unrelated tabs, and updates conversation_url only when marker_in_conversation is True; stronger _is_prompt_echo filter and tab_id trailer stripping; classify_ui_status requires marker_in_conversation=True for returned; cmd_submit post-send confirmation requires marker_in_conversation=True; pre-send inspection reconciles immediately if marker is already present; bounded multi-tab read-only reconciliation handles submit_uncertain and fresh --state-dir encountering an existing remote task.json.

A5 (Collector branch scope, prior snapshots, sanitized tests, no self-referential SHA): added branch write-scope audit via list_commits/get_commit rejecting unauthorized changed files (out_of_scope_branch_change) or explicitly reporting branch_scope_status='scope_unverified' and evidence.branch_write_scope_verified=False when unavailable; verified all prior attempt-01..attempt-(N-1)/task.json snapshots in submit and collect; recursively sanitized/bounded result.json['tests']; rejected self-referential commit SHA keys in result.json (self_referential_commit_sha).

A7 (MCP error classification & strict file parser): unwrap_mcp_envelope inspects ok/isError/success/error at nested data/result levels; tool/server/binary/repository not-found errors are never misclassified as file McpNotFoundError; extract_file_text_from_mcp_envelope rejects directory listings, non-file types (dir/symlink/submodule), and status-only text while preserving valid JSON artifacts.

A8 & A9 (Snapshot metadata, strict JSON, path collisions, URL hardening): added loads_json_strict rejecting duplicate JSON keys; validate_snapshot_matches_contract enforces exact contract_sha256 and snapshot paths; attempt 1 verifies task_snapshot_path does not already exist on base_branch; validate_relative_path blocks jobs/ case-insensitively and rejects case-insensitive duplicates and file/dir prefix collisions; validate_official_url rejects whitespace/control chars, userinfo (@), non-443 ports, backslashes, double slashes, and dot segments.
Added 8 comprehensive regression tests in TestRevision02SecurityAndAuditRegressions covering A1, A2, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, and A9 (41 total unit tests passing).
